yaml.subject: **Amendment requested by the TechTraPlastiCE consortium**

\thispagestyle{fancy}

Since February 2025, the TechTraPlastiCE consortium has been working to strengthen the applied research and technology transfer capacities of Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) in Argentina, Colombia, and Chile. 
The project aims to enhance the service portfolios of participating institutions and support the green transition towards a circular economy within the plastics value chain.
Following the initial implementation phase of the project, the consortium has identified a number of adjustments that are necessary to ensure the successful achievement of the project's objectives and to improve the coherence between the planned activities and the expected deliverables.

On behalf of the TechTraPlastiCE consortium, we therefore kindly request an amendment (AT21) to Grant Agreement No. 101179564 concerning the Description of the Action (DoA), specifically the modifications related to Work Package 3, "*Multi-actor Collaborations for a Just and Safe Plastic Circular Economy*".
The current list of WP3 deliverables is presented in @tbl-link, while the proposed modifications are presented in @tbl-changes.

The requested changes and the reasons for these proposed modifications are detailed below.


1. **New Deliverable D3.1**:
   - Addition of a complementary delivrable called "*Comprehensive Problem Definition on the Reuse Challenge*".
   - *Lead beneficiary*: PUCV.
   - *Due date*: 31 October 2026.
   - *Justification*: The introduction of this new deliverable aims to reflects the actual content of the task T3.1.   
   It provides a comprehensive definition of the reuse challenge identified through stakeholder engagement and analysis in the context of Colombia, Argentina and Chile. Furthermore, assigning PUCV as the lead beneficiary better reflects the distribution of expertise and responsibilities within the consortium, as PUCV is leading the scientific work related to this activity.


1. **Deliverable D3.2**:
   - Change the title of the deliverable entitled "Report on Contacts and Results of Interviews".
   - *Lead beneficiary*: Columbus.
   - *Due date*: 30 March 2027.
   - *Justification*: The purpose of this D3.2 is to maintain the provisions originally set forth in D3.1, while providing a specific report on contacts with stakeholders and the results of the interviews for the planning of the search conference methodology.  
   The challenge in the stakeholder involvement from the experience of the Universidad Central in Colombia, proves the more time is needed to ensure a comprehensive and well-documented engagement process.  
   This report will provide the necessary evidence base for the preparation and implementation of the search conference event across the participating HEIs (UC, PUCV, UNC and UNRN).

1. **Deliverable D3.3**:
   - Title: "Benchmarking Study".
   - *Lead beneficiary*: Columbus.
   - *Due date*: Change of due date from 31 October 2026 to 30 November 2026.
   - *Justification*: This deliverable maintains the insights of the Task 3.3.
   The benchmarking study aims to complement D3.1. It requires additional time to analyse and synthesise the information from multiple countries and institutions.  
   Extending the deadline by one month will ensure a more comprehensive analysis and produce results that will better support the subsequent activities of Work Package 3.

1. **Deliverable D3.4**
   - Change of title from "5 Events Reports (1 per country)" to "Four Search Conference Reports".
   - Lead beneficiary*: Columbus.
   - *Due date*: Change of the due date from 31 January 2027 to 30 June 2027.
   - *Justification*: The proposed title better reflects the activities described in the Description of the Action (DoA). As indicated in the DoA, four search conferences are planned to be organised at the following  Higher Education Institutions:  Universidad Central --UC-- (Colombia) , Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso --PUCV-- (Chile),  Universidad Nacional de Córdoba --UNC-- (Argentina), and Universidad Nacional de Río Negro --UNRN-- (Argentina).  
   The previous title referring to "5 Events Reports" does not accurately represent the planned activity. The revised title therefore corrects this inconsistency and better aligns the deliverable with the approved project.  
  
1. **Deliverable D3.5**:
   - Title: "Updated portfolios" 
   - *Lead beneficiary*: UNS
   - *Due date*: Change of due date from 31 January 2027 to 31 August 2027.
   - *Justification*: The updated institutional portfolios are directly dependent on the outcomes of the Search Conferences. Since the completion of these conferences is proposed for June 2027, extending the deadline for Deliverable D3.5 to 31 August 2027 will provide sufficient time for each participating university to integrate the agreed initiatives into its portfolio and produce a high-quality final deliverable.


The implementation of the WP3 requires extensive coordination with external stakeholders representing the plastics value chain in each country.
Scheduling the workshops depends on the availability of numerous socio-economic actors and therefore involves factors that cannot be fully controlled by the consortium.
For this reason, the consortium proposes extending the WP3 to 31 August 2027. 
This additional time will ensure that all Search Conferences are successfully organised, their outcomes are properly documented, and the resulting action plans can effectively support the implementation of Work Package 4.
**These modifications do not affect the objectives, methodology, or expected impact of Work Package 3, nor do they compromise the overall objectives or implementation of the TechTraPlastiCE project**.

The consortium remains fully committed to achieving the objectives of the TechTraPlastiCE project and believes that these adjustments will strengthen its overall implementation without affecting its expected outcomes.

We kindly ask for your consideration of this amendment request and remain at your disposal should you require any additional information or clarification.

Thank you for your continued support and cooperation.

Yours sincerely,


On behalf of the TechTraPlastiCE Consortium
